formattedAddress: No. 81號, Jinghua St, Xingfu Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

displayName.text: 味香閣（私房料理、家常料理）

text.text:
Jingmei doesn't have many good restaurants compared to newer ones; there aren't many food options. This place is alright, though; the menu isn't small, but the portions are really small.

This place was recommended by someone, and the food is decent, but the portions are really small. Plus, there are no waiters, and they don't even provide hot water. The service is poor, which is a shame considering the chefs' skills. The owner should improve their business philosophy; otherwise, they would be more profitable.

originalText.text:
景美沒有什麼好餐廳跟新店比 吃的真的不多 但這家算還可以 菜色不算少 但份量實在不多
這家經人介紹 味道還算不錯 但是真的份量不多 加上餐廳沒有服務員 連開水都不供應 服務不到位 可惜了後台師父的功力 老闆經營觀點應該改善 獲利應就會更好

text.text: Each dish is served in small portions, suitable for 2-3 people or a small family to share. The interior is clean and bright, and the dishes are also clean and refreshing. I especially liked the anchovy fried rice, which was very fragrant and delicious! The shrimp paste water spinach was also crisp and delicious! The only minor drawback is that no plain water is provided, and drinks (including plain water) must be purchased at your own expense.

originalText.text: 每道菜的份量都小小的、適合2-3人或小家庭一起分食，內用環境整潔明亮，菜餚也很乾淨清爽，特別喜歡吻仔魚炒飯，很香很好吃！蝦醬空心菜也爽脆好吃！唯一小缺點就是沒有提供白開水，飲料（包括白開水）都要自費購買。

text.text:
The restaurant has a limited number of tables for dine-in, but it's usually packed during mealtimes, so reservations are highly recommended. Parking is not difficult nearby; there is a parking lot, but it's about a 5-10 minute walk. If you're lucky, you might find a parking space on the street.

1. Shredded Pork Fried Rice: Incredibly fragrant, with each grain distinct. You'll definitely want to keep eating it. Adding some scallions would make it even better.

2. Scallion-Fried Beef: A must-order. The beef is very tender and goes perfectly with the fried rice. The downside is that it's a little oily, but within acceptable limits.

3. Seafood Taro Rice Noodle Soup: Unfortunately, there wasn't much taro. However, it's a must-order here. Highly recommended. Plenty of ingredients, and the soup is incredibly delicious—sweet and savory. The wide rice noodles have a great chewy texture.

Taste is subjective, so I suggest you try it yourself to see if it suits your taste.

originalText.text:
內用桌數不多，但用餐時高鵬滿座，建議提前預約。附近，停車不難，有停車場，但需步行約五至十分。運氣好路邊能找到停車格。

1.肉絲炒飯。香氣十足，粒粒分明。保證會讓你一口接著一口。如果可以加點蔥花那就太棒了。
2.蔥爆牛肉。推薦必點。肉質十分嫩，配炒飯真的很搭。缺點是稍微油。但能接受的範圍。
3.海鮮芋頭米粉湯。可惜芋頭稍微少。但，來此店必點。真心推薦。料多不說，湯非常好喝。鮮甜。寬米粉口感很Q。
吃的很主觀，建議親自來試試才會知道合不合口味。

text.text:
The first time I came, I ordered shrimp fried rice. The egg was very fluffy, and the shrimp were very chewy. It was quite delicious.

The second time, I ordered the dry-fried beef noodles. The beef noodles were stir-fried with scallions and onions, and the accompanying bean sprouts and vermicelli were also well-seasoned, with a refreshing and refreshing flavor.

Dim Sum: Purple Sweet Potato Roll

The outer skin is made from spring roll wrappers, and the filling is a mix of purple sweet potato and yam, with dried fruit and pomelo. The inside is very fluffy and the flavor is quite good.

Overall, the food is quite delicious, the environment is quite clean, and the service is very friendly. It's a new stir-fry restaurant in Jingmei. It's quite delicious. You should give it a try.

originalText.text:
第一次來點的是蝦仁炒飯，蛋的味道很綿密，蝦仁也很Q彈，味道蠻好的。

第二次點的是乾炒牛河，牛河搭配上蔥和洋炒得很香，招待的小菜豆芽菜冬粉也不馬虎，調味的很清爽解膩。

點心：紫薯桔捲

外皮以春捲的皮製成，內餡以紫薯和蕃薯做混搭再加上果乾以及柚子乾搭配而成，裡面很綿密，味道還算不錯～

整體來說東西蠻好吃的，環境也蠻乾淨的，店員服務態度也蠻好，是在景美一間新開的熱炒店，蠻好吃的～可以來試試看～

text.text: A restaurant you can always come to, you can order every dish, and you have never stepped on a thunder. The boss's cooking skills are extraordinary, and he has a variety of dishes. The seasoning is salty and sweet, and the heat is just right. Today he also treated me to a small surprise, thank you boss

originalText.text: 可以一直來的店，每一道菜都可以點，從沒踩過雷。老闆的手藝不凡，各路菜式都有涉略，調味鹹甜適口、火侯恰到好處，今天也招待小驚喜，感謝老闆
